name: SPECIALIZATION IN GEOLOGY AND BIOLOGY
title: SPECIALIZATION IN GEOLOGY AND BIOLOGY Faculty of Science - Earth Sciences

sections.heading: SPECIALIZATION IN GEOLOGY AND BIOLOGY
lines: Completion of first-year requirements. Students must have a minimum of 60% in each of 3.0 principal courses taken, including:
Biology 1001A or Biology 1201A and Biology 1002B or Biology 1202B;

Plus 1.0 additional course from: Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, and one of Applied Mathematics 1201A/B, Calculus 1301A/B or Calculus 1501A/B, Mathematics 1600A/B, Data Science 1000A/B or the former Statistical Sciences 1024A/B; or Mathematics 1225A/B and Mathematics 1229A/B. This requirement must be completed by the end of Year 2.
3.5 courses: Earth Sciences 2200A/B, Earth Sciences 2206A/B, Earth Sciences 2250Y, Earth Sciences 2260A/B, Earth Sciences 2265A/B, Earth Sciences 2266F/G, Earth Sciences 3314A/B.

1.5 courses from: Earth Sciences 2240F/G, Earth Sciences 2241A/B, Earth Sciences 3340A/B, Earth Sciences 3369A/B, Earth Sciences 4460A/B, Earth Sciences 4461A/B, Earth Sciences 4462A/B, the former Earth Sciences 4400A/B.
2.5 courses: Biology 2290F/G, Biology 2581A/B, Biology 2382A/B, Biology 2483A/B, Biology 2601A/B, the former Biology 2486A.
0.5 course from: Chemistry 2213A/B or Earth Sciences 2230A/B.

1.5 courses from: Biology 2244A/B, Biology 2471A/B, Biology 3404F/G, Biology 3484A/B, or the former Biology 2240F/G, the former Biology 2660A/B, the former Biology 3651A/B, or the former Microbiology and Immunology 2100A. Note: Biology 2244A/B is recommended.
